note: Limits are the baseline x 1.5 (memory x 1.3), rounded up. The baseline is the highest median of 3 CI runs of the fresh-machine job on ubuntu-latest (Nov 12, 2026): runner speed varies a lot between jobs (cold start median 0.30 s in one job, 0.57-0.58 s in two others). browser_launch_s has no limit until a CI run has measured it. Rewrite with `perf_budget.py --update-baseline` on purpose.
